title: Boosting Data Center Performance via Intelligently Managed Multi-backend Disaggregated Memory
problem: Disaggregated memory systems suffer from underutilized far memory bandwidth, limiting data throughput for data-intensive applications. Existing designs target only single PCIe-based secondary memory devices with low bandwidth and high system overhead.
motivation: Improving memory bandwidth utilization and task throughput is critical for efficient data center operations processing large-scale data-intensive workloads.
method: xDM presents a multi-backend disaggregated memory management scheme that dynamically builds and implicitly selects appropriate far memory access paths. A smart configuration strategy optimizes bandwidth usage by tuning key parameters based on synthesized application page data characteristics.
key_novelty: First multi-backend disaggregated memory system that intelligently manages scale-out far memory paths instead of single-backend architectures.
contributions: Multi-backend disaggregated memory architecture enabling scale-out far memory paths
Dynamic far memory path selection and construction mechanism
Smart configuration strategy that tunes parameters based on application page data
3.9x data swap performance speedup, 2.8x data throughput, and 5.1x task throughput improvements
